Spiderplot Creation

Preparing world environment

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

Loading required files

loadings_df <- read.csv("~/Savolainen Lab/SSB/Data/Personality/pca_loadings_all.csv")
RC1_loadings <- read.csv("~/Savolainen Lab/SSB/Data/Personality/rc1_loading.csv")
RC2_loadings <- read.csv("~/Savolainen Lab/SSB/Data/Personality/rc2_loading.csv")
RC3_loadings <- read.csv("~/Savolainen Lab/SSB/Data/Personality/rc3_loading.csv")

personality_summary <- read.csv("~/Savolainen Lab/SSB/Data/Personality/new_filtered_personality_summarised.csv")

Plotting a Spiderplot for loadings relative to each RC

Creating a table with threshold 0.40 for all RCs

spider_loadings <- loadings_df %>%
  filter(
    abs(RC1) >= 0.40 |
    abs(RC2) >= 0.40 |
    abs(RC3) >= 0.40
  )

Ordering of loadings

behaviour_order <-
  spider_loadings %>%
  mutate(
    strongest_RC = case_when(
      abs(RC1) >= abs(RC2) & abs(RC1) >= abs(RC3) ~ "RC1",
      abs(RC2) >= abs(RC1) & abs(RC2) >= abs(RC3) ~ "RC2",
      TRUE                                        ~ "RC3"
    ),

    strongest_loading = pmax(
      abs(RC1),
      abs(RC2),
      abs(RC3)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    strongest_RC,
    desc(strongest_loading)
  )

behaviour_order

Converting data into suitable format

library(tidyr)

spider_RC <-
  spider_loadings %>%
  dplyr::select(Behaviour, RC1, RC2, RC3) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("RC"),
    names_to = "Component",
    values_to = "Loading"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Behaviour,
    values_from = Loading
  )

spider_RC <-
  spider_RC %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Component,
    all_of(behaviour_order$Behaviour)
  )

# renaming the components
spider_RC$Component <- c(
  "Social Confidence",
  "Assertiveness",
  "Evasiveness"
)

Plotting using ggplot2

Preparing data

# Converting loadings into long format
plot_data <-
  spider_loadings %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Behaviour,
    RC1,
    RC2,
    RC3
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("RC"),
    names_to = "Component",
    values_to = "Loading"
  )

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    Component = dplyr::recode(
      Component,
      RC1 = "Social Confidence",
      RC2 = "Assertiveness",
      RC3 = "Evasiveness"
    )
  )

# Joining behaviour ordering
plot_data <-
  plot_data %>%
  left_join(
    behaviour_order %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Behaviour,
        strongest_RC,
        strongest_loading
      ),
    by = "Behaviour"
  )

# Number of behaviours
n_beh <- nrow(behaviour_order)

# Calculating equally spaced angles
behaviour_angles <-
  tibble(
    Behaviour = behaviour_order$Behaviour,
    angle = seq(
      0,
      2 * pi,
      length.out = n_beh + 1
    )[-(n_beh + 1)]
  )

# Adding angles to plotting data
plot_data <-
  plot_data %>%
  left_join(
    behaviour_angles,
    by = "Behaviour"
  )

# Converting loadings to plotting radius
zero_radius <- 1

plot_data <-
  plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    radius = zero_radius + Loading
  )

# Calculating Cartesian coordinates
plot_data <-
  plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    x = radius * cos(angle),
    y = radius * sin(angle)
  )

# Closing polygons
polygon_data <-
  plot_data %>%
  group_by(Component) %>%
  arrange(angle) %>%
  slice(
    c(
      1:n(),
      1
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Preparing behaviour labels
label_data <-
  behaviour_order %>%
  left_join(
    behaviour_angles,
    by = "Behaviour"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label_radius = 2.2,
    x = label_radius * cos(angle),
    y = label_radius * sin(angle)
  )

label_data <-
  label_data %>%
  mutate(
    Label = case_when(
      Behaviour == "Other species interaction" ~ "Other species\ninteraction",
      Behaviour == "Stationary in proximity" ~ "Stationary\nin proximity",
      TRUE ~ Behaviour
    )
  )

# Calculating text rotation
label_data <-
  label_data %>%
  mutate(
    angle_deg = angle * 180 / pi,

    text_angle = ifelse(
      angle_deg > 90 &
        angle_deg < 270,
      angle_deg + 180,
      angle_deg
    ),

    hjust = ifelse(
      angle_deg > 90 &
        angle_deg < 270,
      1,
      0
    )
  )

# Component colours
component_cols <- c(
  "Social Confidence" = "#2C7FB8",
  "Assertiveness"     = "#B2182B",
  "Evasiveness"       = "#31A354"
)

component_shapes <- c(
  "Social Confidence" = 16,  # circle
  "Assertiveness"     = 17,  # triangle
  "Evasiveness"       = 15   # square
)

# Calculating sector boundaries
sector_limits <-
  behaviour_order %>%
  mutate(
    angle = behaviour_angles$angle
  ) %>%
  group_by(strongest_RC) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(angle),
    end = max(angle),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

spacing <- 2*pi / n_beh

sector_limits <-
  behaviour_order %>%
  mutate(angle = behaviour_angles$angle) %>%
  group_by(strongest_RC) %>%
  summarise(
    first_angle = first(angle),
    last_angle  = last(angle),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start = first_angle - spacing/2,
    end   = last_angle  + spacing/2
  )

# Creating circular grid
circle_grid <-
  crossing(
    radius = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2),
    theta = seq(
      0,
      2*pi,
      length.out = 500
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x = radius*cos(theta),
    y = radius*sin(theta),

    line_colour = case_when(
      radius == 1 ~ "zero",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )

# Creating radial spokes
spokes <-
  behaviour_angles %>%
  mutate(
    x = 2 * cos(angle),
    y = 2 * sin(angle)
  )

Plotting the figure

library(ggplot2)

# Creating the base plot
p <-
  ggplot() +

# Drawing circular gridlines
# Light grey circles except zero
geom_path(
  data = filter(circle_grid, radius != 1),
  aes(
    x,
    y,
    group = radius
  ),
  colour = "grey75",
  linewidth = 0.9
) +

# Drawing radial spokes
geom_segment(
  data = spokes,
  aes(
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    xend = x,
    yend = y
  ),
  colour = "grey82",
  linewidth = 0.35
)

# Drawing the three loading polygons
p <-
  p +

geom_path(
  data = polygon_data,
  aes(
    x,
    y,
    group = Component,
    colour = Component
  ),
  linewidth = 1.2
) +

geom_point(
  data = plot_data,
  aes(
    x,
    y,
    colour = Component,
    shape = Component
  ),
  size = 4.5
)

# Draw zero-loading circle on top of everything
p <- p +
  geom_path(
    data = filter(circle_grid, radius == 1),
    aes(
      x,
      y,
      group = radius
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "grey20",
    linewidth = 1.5
  )

# Setting colour and shape scales
p <- p +

scale_colour_manual(
  name = NULL,
  values = component_cols,
  breaks = c(
    "Social Confidence",
    "Assertiveness",
    "Evasiveness"
  )
) +

scale_shape_manual(
  name = NULL,
  values = component_shapes,
  breaks = c(
    "Social Confidence",
    "Assertiveness",
    "Evasiveness"
  )
) +

guides(
  colour = guide_legend(
    order = 1,
    override.aes = list(
      shape = c(16,17,15),
      linewidth = 1.4,
      size = 4
    )
  ),
  shape = "none"
)

Tidying the figure

# Adding behaviour labels
p <-
  p +

geom_text(
  data = label_data,
  aes(
    x,
    y,
    label = Label,
    angle = text_angle,
    hjust = hjust
  ),
  size = 6.8,
  family = "sans"
)

# Creating radial axis labels
axis_labels <- tibble(
  Label = c("-1", "0", "1"),
  x = c(0.12, 0.18, 0.12),
  y = c(0, 1.12, 2)
)

# Finishing the plot
p <-
  p +

coord_equal(
    clip = "off"
) +

scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(-3.0, 3.0),
  expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)
) +

scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(-3.0, 3.0),
  expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)
) +

labs(
  colour = NULL) +
    
theme_void(base_size = 18)


library(cowplot)

legend <- get_legend(
  p +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 24),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 24)
    )
)

p <- p +
geom_text(
    data = axis_labels,
    aes(x, y, label = Label),
    colour = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 9
)

plot_only <-
  p +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )


final_plot <-
  plot_grid(
    plot_only,
    legend,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.88, 0.12)
  )

# Displaying the figure
final_plot

# Saving publication-quality figure
ggsave(
  filename = "~/Savolainen Lab/Figures/PCA_custom_radar_plot.tiff",
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 12.5,
  height = 12.5,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
